purpose: Static vetting groundwork for the Session-039B Docker-only execution path. Digests were resolved over the public Docker Hub registry API without executing or pulling anything. Floating tags move; any approved environment MUST re-resolve, pull, inspect and re-verify before use, then pin the BUILT evaluation image by its own immutable digest.

verification_performed_here: Docker Hub auth token scoped to repository:library/node:pull
HEAD manifest request returned Docker-Content-Digest for the multi-arch index
amd64 manifest digest extracted from the OCI index
config blob decoded to confirm NODE_VERSION=24.22.2

planned_evaluation_image.contents: node:24 pinned base + globally installed prisma CLI and @prisma/client 6.19.3 with bundled query/migration engines (downloaded at image build time so eval containers need no network)
planned_evaluation_image.pinning_rule: Build only inside an approved image workflow; push the built image to a registry, record its manifest digest (image@sha256:<64-hex>, from RepoDigests after the push — never the bare local image ID) and pass that exact digest to archagent.s039 evaluators. The evaluators refuse floating tags and bare sha256 IDs and never pull, so the digest-pinned image must be pulled onto every runner that executes it.

security_notes: The route evaluator container needs an exec-permitted tmpfs workspace solely because the trusted Prisma query-engine library must be loadable from a writable location; nosuid is retained, the image root stays read-only, all capabilities are dropped and the network is disabled.
The invariant evaluator keeps the stricter noexec tmpfs.
Candidate code never receives repo credentials; CI checkout happens outside the candidate container and only the candidate directory plus the trusted harness directory are bind-mounted read-only.
